text:
Alex: quick heads-up: seeing growing small-host-page fragmentation after offload. lots of 4K/8K 'ghost' pages not reused and fragmenting host pools.
Maria: can you paste a snippet? is it tenant-local or global?
Alex: brief slab sample:
# slab-summary
pool host-staging: total 48G used 34G free-frags: 1180 (avg 4K)
resident-pages: 1.1M ghost-marked: 72K
Sam: likely due to grace windows we added to avoid races with in-flight kernels. we never compact ghosts aggressively.
Taylor: tradeoff: eager reclaim = correctness risk; lazy = fragmentation bloat.
Alex: proposal: add a 'staged-ghost' state withTTL-based confirmation. on offload mark pages staged-ghost + ticket. if no kernel confirm within X ms, promote reclaimable. confirmations come from completion queue events.
Maria: also coalesce contiguous staged runs and compact in batched passes. prefer async moves to cold compact pool, avoid memmove in hot tail.
Sam: need a safety contract: any kernel that may reference page must post ticket before reclamation. we'll formalize in RFC.
Taylor: add backpressure: throttle offloads when fragmentation > threshold to avoid OOM storms.
Alex: instrumentation: staged_ghost_count, coalesced_run_len, compaction_cycles, per-tenant frag-delta. perfbot: will add charts and alert if staged_ghost_count > 50k for 10m.
Maria: plan: canary TTL=500ms, run mixed workload 12h, measure p99 tokens/sec and frag delta. I'll draft RFC diagram and checklist.
Sam: I'll add microbench harness.
Taylor: add immediate rollback toggle to disable compaction if correctness issues.
Alex: opening RFC PR tomorrow. sync 10am to review metrics.
perfbot: noted and added dashboards.
